entities.summary:
Article 1 - Democratic and Progressive Movement (French: Article 1 - Mouvement démocrate et progressiste, also known as 'L'Article 1') was a French social democratic political party founded in 2017 when former Prime Minister Manuel Valls left the Socialist Party to support Emmanuel Macron's En Marche! movement — a split that symbolized the Socialist Party's catastrophic collapse as Macron's centrist movement attracted numerous center-left figures away from the traditional left.

Manuel Valls had been Prime Minister under Socialist President François Hollande from 2014-2016 before resigning to run unsuccessfully in the 2017 presidential primary. His decision to subsequently support Macron's centrist La République En Marche! rather than support the Socialist Party's candidate Benoît Hamon was part of the broader defection of centrist Social Democrats to Macron that effectively destroyed the French Socialist Party's national viability in the 2017 elections (Hamon received only 6.36% in the first round).

Article 1 represented an attempt to create a vehicle for Valls and other center-left Social Democrats who supported Macron while maintaining a distinct political identity — in practice, the organization merged into or closely aligned with La République En Marche! The broader significance is as documentation of the French left's 2017 collapse and the centrist reconfiguration of French politics under Macron that left both the traditional left and the traditional right fragmented.
